sentences.text:
For the Respondent/s : Mr. Rishi Raj Sinha, SC-19  Mr. Birendra Prasad Singh, A.C. to S.C.-1  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 5 21-02-2023 No one appears for the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the State is present.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the State that as per the stand of the respondents, the petitioner would not be entitled to compensation in terms of the 2013 Act in view of fact that not only the award was prepared but even possession of the land was taken prior to coming in force of the 2013 Act.

On perusal of the counter affidavit filed on behalf of respondent nos. 2, 3 and 4, the Court finds that the date of payment of the compensation (or 80% of the compensation) has not been given in the counter affidavit.

At this stage reference may be made to section 24(2) of the Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

Land Acquisition,

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Let a supplementary affidavit be filed by respondent nos. 2, 3 and 4 with respect to the date of payment of Patna High Court CWJC No.3249 of 2020(5) dt.21-02-2023 compensation to the petitioner, as has been mentioned in paragraph no.8 of the counter affidavit sworn by the District Land Acquisition Officer, Saran on 13.9.2022.
Put up this case after three weeks.

(Partha Sarthy, J) avinash/-
